_comment: Single source of truth for the capability/slot policies that exist twice: agent-contract/CapabilityActionPolicy.kt + CalendarTitlePolicy.kt (Kotlin, runs on device) and tools/agent_eval/agent_policies.py (Python, runs the Mac evaluation). Both test suites read this file, so a rule that changes in one language and not the other fails immediately.
